name: live-your-life
description: A life sim in a fictional Rust Belt city: isometric, drawn in code, for the browser and Google Play.

scripts.lint: biome check . && node tools/purity/src/cli.ts && node --no-warnings tools/voice/cli.ts && pnpm eb validate packages/content --types tools/content/game.ts

scripts.content: pnpm eb build packages/content --types tools/content/game.ts --out packages/content/pack.json
